tracking: ADR-0345 slice 3: the agent-risk register's read and settings APIs; the register view belongs to a design builder and is posted on #453

gaps.GET /v1/agent-risks: lists every agent risk with its OWASP references, controls and proofs, each proof's schedule and its latest result labelled as evidence
gaps.GET /v1/agent-risks/proofs/:proofKey/res: pages one proof's results, newest first, each with its evidence label
gaps.PUT /v1/agent-risks/proofs/:proofKey/set: turns a proof on or off or changes its interval; a relaxation needs a settings_relax step-up and is audited
